show.name: get

get.name: get
get.description: Returns detailed information about a specific rootserver.

backupsIndex.name: backupsIndex
backupsIndex.description: Returns all backups for a rootserver.

ddosServer.name: ddosServer
ddosServer.summary: List DDoS alerts for a server
ddosServer.description: Returns paginated DDoS alerts for a specific rootserver. Bandwidth and packet metrics are only visible when can_view_ddos_metrics is enabled.

status.description: Filter by status (detecting, active, mitigated, ended)

severity.description: Filter by severity (low, medium, high, critical)

firewallRules.name: firewallRules
firewallRules.description: Returns all firewall rules for a rootserver.

historicalStats.name: historicalStats
historicalStats.description: Returns historical stats with automatic granularity based on time range.

liveStats.name: liveStats
liveStats.description: Returns real-time CPU, RAM, disk, and network stats from Proxmox.

rdnsIndex.name: rdnsIndex
rdnsIndex.description: Returns all IP addresses with their rDNS records for a rootserver.

serverTasksIndex.name: serverTasksIndex
serverTasksIndex.description: Returns a paginated list of tasks for a specific rootserver.

backupsCreate.name: backupsCreate
backupsCreate.description: Creates a new backup. Returns 202 with a task for tracking.
backupsCreate.label: Backup erstellen

firewallApply.name: firewallApply
firewallApply.description: Applies a firewall preset to a rootserver. Replaces all existing rules. Returns 202 with a task.
firewallApply.label: Firewall anwenden

firewallRulesCreate.description: Creates a new firewall rule and syncs to Proxmox.
firewallRulesCreate.label: Firewall-Regel erstellen

isoCustom.summary: Mount custom ISO from HTTPS URL
isoCustom.description: Proxmox downloads the ISO, mounts it as CD-ROM and prefers CD boot. Unmount deletes the custom file.

isoCustom.label: Eigene ISO einlegen

isoUnmount.description: Unmounts the CD-ROM. A custom ISO downloaded via URL is deleted from storage.
isoUnmount.label: ISO auswerfen

rdnsUpdate.description: Updates the rDNS record for an IP address. Returns 202 with a task for tracking.
rdnsUpdate.label: Reverse DNS ändern
